title: Menus now preload motorcycle and venue sounds (#626)
summary: Menu preload now also prepares motorcycle sound banks and late-added venue clips (crowd, train, rain, actors) on background decode workers, so Start has fewer sounds left to load.
details: Previously motorcycle PCM and late-added venue clips stayed on Start's sound-loading path. They now use the background decode workers and the existing decoded cache; cancellation, debounce, session and memory limits remain, frame-loop code is unchanged, and the retained course buffer is released before the sound-name job reads its cached archive. Host-only Chromium warm-menu samples, first frame to sounds ready: motorcycle ENV01 486 to 106-135 ms; ENV08 train 763 to 535-549 ms with misses after Start 3 to 0; SX01 crowd/blimp 1,651 to 695-811 ms with misses 9 to 0; ENV03 plane 730 to 504-594 ms with misses 1 to 0; ENV04 verifies an active rain voice with zero warm misses. Passed: make precheck, make web, the native worker unit test, test_engine_menu_preload_ride.mjs and test_engine_menu_preload.mjs (longest preparation task 52 ms).
limitation: Single-run host samples, not phone timing. Cold motorcycle timing is not shown to improve, and SX01 bank cache writes rise from 44.7 to 60.7 MB. Objective and mini-game overlays still need mode-aware preload targets, and the direct-load gap remains. The screenshot shows the ride scene only; the timings above come from the tests.
